factProposals.value: CMS HCRIS cost reports carry exactly one figure per metric per hospital fiscal year -- there is no month field anywhere in the source data, so 'monthly metrics' cannot be derived from this import without inventing data.
factProposals.evidence: pipeline/schema.sql#cost_report_years (fiscal_year int, no month column); REQ-002 itself says 'per hospital per year'

factProposals.value: operating_margin_pct, days_cash_on_hand, and days_in_ar are Postgres GENERATED ALWAYS AS ... STORED columns computed directly from the imported raw values, so a stored metric can never drift from its inputs.

Every computed metric carries field-level provenance, not just a source file/report id: a jsonb column recording the exact {worksheet, line, column} it was read from and whether that line was present (ok), absent (not_reported), or present but unparseable (unparseable).

decisions.statement: A NULL metric value is never left ambiguous -- metric_provenance always states why it is NULL (not_reported vs unparseable), rather than treating every missing value the same way.
decisions.rationale: a NULL that could mean 'line wasn't filed' or 'line was garbled' is not trustworthy for a system whose entire premise is trust; a hospital financial system needs to distinguish those cases
decisions.evidence: pipeline/hcris_import.py#extract_metrics; live backfill confirmed 18 of 652 rows genuinely not_reported for cash_on_hand

limitations.statement: This story's own acceptance criteria asks for a 'standard set of monthly metrics', but the CMS HCRIS data this story imports is annual-only. That criterion is left unticked rather than reworded or satisfied with invented data. Monthly granularity belongs to a different, later data source: operator-uploaded internal exports (REQ-007/REQ-011, STORY-005/STORY-011, release r2), which is where 'monthly metrics' actually applies.
limitations.evidence: .colaberry/progress.json STORY-002 criteria[0]; REQ-002 vs REQ-011 wording in .colaberry/plan.json

demonstrationEvidence.ref: pipeline/test_hcris_import.py (30 tests, including the provider-scoped dedupe fix found while backfilling provenance); live backfill of all 652 existing cost_report_years rows to non-empty metric_provenance, confirmed via direct query (0 rows left empty, 18 rows genuinely not_reported for cash_on_hand); documented in PROGRESS.md's 2026-09-22 'Close STORY-001's two remaining gaps' entry
